delivery.commit_subject: BP5-GCP-002: add nonprod runtime foundation bootstrap

handoffs.message: Implemented BP5-GCP-002 with scripts/gcp_nonprod_foundation.sh and doc updates in Pantheon_GCP_GitHub_Docker_正式部署與環境設計_v2.md plus docs/remote-dev-gcp-vm.md. The new bootstrap provisions dev/sandbox split runtime identities and secrets, nonprod VPC/subnets, private-service-access, private Cloud SQL instances, Pub/Sub backbone topics/subscriptions, VPC connectors, and internal-only Cloud Run deploy prerequisites. Verified with bash -n and a full --dry-run render.

Review approved: gcp_nonprod_foundation.sh correctly provisions dev/sandbox VPC, PSA, private Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub backbone, VPC connectors, and internal-only ingress prerequisites. All acceptance criteria met. Returned to Codex2 for finalization.
